description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the CachingClientFactory class, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as failure handling, concurrency, retries, and state clearing.

classes.name: CachingClientFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CachingClientFactory, containing multiple test cases for creation/caching logic, error handling, concurrency, retries, and state management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Vertx mock instance and sets up timer behavior for immediate execution.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateClientFailsIfSupplierFails
methods.description: Tests that client creation fails correctly when the supplier returns a failed Future.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateClientFailsIfInvokedConcurrently
methods.description: Tests that a concurrent creation attempt fails appropriately if an initial creation is in progress.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateClientSucceedsOnRetry
methods.description: Ensures that a client creation succeeds on retry if the initial creation completes before the first retry.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateClientFailsWhenStateIsCleared
methods.description: Verifies that clearing the factory's state causes ongoing creation attempts to fail immediately, but subsequent attempts succeed.
